atoms.b: Rahul, Arjun and Naveen are three best friends living in a city in the north-east of India. In the mornings, they go to the river together to swim and do their chores.

atoms.b: After they are done with their chores for the day, Rahul, Arjun and Naveen like to play football. They play in a busy park and make up their own goals and lines. Usually, they can find lots of other kids to play with them too. Then, they have to go home, and it is time for dinner.
